messages:
ana (partnerships): hey team — kicking off a small pilot for SI co-sell lead routing called 'quiet-sparrow'. goal: reduce duplicate outreach and speed up initial response for joint opportunities. planning to run for 8 weeks.

mike (sales): sounds good. what's the proposed ownership flow? :thinking_face:

ana (partnerships): proposal — inbound partner-intake leads go to a shared queue in SFDC. partner-onboarding tag = 'QS-pilot'. Within 24h the SI must claim in queue or it escalates to regional AE. claim = add SI ownership record + post in #partner-claims.

leah (si-ops): can you clarify "claim" steps? is that manual or API-driven?

ana (partnerships): manual for now (pilot). we’ll add a one-click Claim button in the UI that sets the ownership fields. later we'll automate via webhooks. minimal fields: SI name, SI contact, claimed_ts, route_reason.

jordan (revops): we'll need a new SFDC field to avoid overwriting AE ownership. suggest: partner_claim_owner, partner_claim_ts, partner_claim_source. revops can add these today if approved.

mike (sales): important: territory locks. if AE has an active opportunity (stg != 00 New), partner shouldn't steal without AE approval. how do we enforce?

ana (partnerships): rule: if opportunity stage > New && AE owner exists -> send email to AE + 24h window for AE to respond. if no response, partner can request co-sell via escalation form. logging required.

leah (si-ops): what about region exceptions? some SI partners have APAC-only rights.

ana (partnerships): we'll add a partner_allowed_regions tag and evaluate at intake. if mismatch -> auto-reject with suggested partner intro list.

mike (sales): SLA on initial connect with customer?

ana (partnerships): target: SI initial outreach within 48h of claim. reportable metric for pilot. non-compliance -> automated warning to partner manager and reduced route score.

jordan (revops): need mapping doc for which partners can claim which accounts. suggest a single CSV stored in Confluence and linked from SFDC lookup. i'll draft mapping schema.

leah (si-ops): for audit, we should write an event to the partner_claim_history table with claim_reason and any overrides.

ana (partnerships): agreed. also: marketplace SKUs — if lead comes from cloud marketplace listing, partner credits apply only if lead matches SKU mapping. include SKU field at intake.

mike (sales): legal/NDAs? some partners require an NDA before joint outreach.

ana (partnerships): add NDA_required boolean on intake. if true, route to legal & partner manager first (48h review). don't claim until NDA cleared.

leah (si-ops): do we want an internal slack flow? like a /partner-claim command that pings #partner-claims with link + metadata.

ana (partnerships): yes — build /partner-claim for pilot. simple payload: lead_id, si_name, si_contact, claim_ts, intake_notes.

deploy-bot: reminder — staging webhook for /partner-claim ready at https://hooks.redwood-ai.test/partner-claim (use token QS-PILOT)

jordan (revops): next step: i'll provision SFDC fields and export sample mapping template by EOD tomorrow. ana, can you confirm pilot partner list (3 SIs) and the Confluence link?

ana (partnerships): confirmed — partners: SummitSys, BlueApex, VectorForge. confluence: https://redwood-internal.atl/confluence/display/PRT/quiet-sparrow-pilot (draft). please review and comment.

mike (sales): thumbs up from me. quick ask — add a column for 'lead_source' so we can filter marketplaces vs organic.

ana (partnerships): will do. thanks everyone — if no objections i'll lock these rules and start the pilot onboarding tomorrow morning. :rocket:

leah (si-ops): no objections. keeping an eye on claim abuse metrics.

jordan (revops): proceeding with field additions.

mike (sales): go for it.

ana (partnerships): closing thread — will post kickoff checklist in #partner-ops and ping partners. if you want to be on the daily sync, reply here and i'll add you to the invite.
